risk: ERP exit inherits the TSA22 integration dependency and the TSA29 network dependency creating a three-hop critical path with little float
mitigation: Jointly plan TSA01 TSA22 and TSA29 on one critical path; hold weekly dependency reviews; pre-agree integration and connectivity fallback runbooks

risk: Warehouse and reporting exit slips because TSA20 depends on TSA22 while TSA21 and TSA34 both depend on TSA20
mitigation: Sequence data extraction after integration stabilisation; maintain a single warehouse dependency register; test reverse extracts in parallel with buyer reporting cutover

risk: Quality records access is exposed because TSA12 depends on TSA25 manufacturing execution hosting and TSA33 depends on TSA12
mitigation: Lock quality record retention requirements early; run a joint MES and QMS dependency test; agree a seller access fallback before TSA25 exit planning completes

risk: Engineering data and BOM migration is constrained by TSA14 dependence on TSA28 data centre hosting and TSA29 network services
mitigation: Complete an engineering data dependency map; validate data centre and network capacity before design sign-off; stage BOM extracts in controlled batches

risk: Payroll continuity is at risk because TSA06 depends on TSA18 identity services and TSA32 reverse payroll extracts depend on TSA06
mitigation: Run payroll and identity dependency tests together; agree manual payroll fallback; freeze identity changes during parallel runs

risk: Email transition for about 2400 users depends on TSA18 identity services and a fixed TSA26 end date
mitigation: Baseline mailbox and identity volumes early; test federation and mail routing weekly; agree an extension trigger before the TSA26 exit gate

risk: Plant hosting exit is delayed because TSA28 depends on TSA29 and covers three critical on-premises applications
mitigation: Reserve network capacity for plant systems; validate site failover before data centre design freeze; maintain local hosting fallback for critical shifts

risk: Indirect tax is among the earliest TSA exits (month 6) and depends only on APP007 leaving limited runway for filing continuity
mitigation: Start tax filing continuity testing in the first 30 days; confirm filing calendar and evidence owners; pre-approve a short extension if testing slips

risk: Supplier portal access for about 1400 users depends on seller consent and a short TSA05 runway
mitigation: Confirm consent and data export rights early; test supplier access fallback; agree a supplier communication plan before TSA05 end date

risk: Service desk continuity is exposed because TSA30 depends on TSA18 while supporting about 2400 users
mitigation: Stand up a buyer service desk bridge on day one; baseline ticket volumes and knowledge gaps; rehearse queue and telephony failover
